an6.21:3.2: “Last night, mendicants, a glorious deity, lighting up the entire lotus pond, came up to me; coming up to me, bowing, the deity stood to one side. Standing to one side, mendicants, that deity said to me:
an6.21:3.3: ‘Sir, three qualities lead to the decline of a mendicant.
an6.21:3.6: These three qualities lead to the decline of a mendicant.’
an6.21:3.8: Having said this, the deity bowed to me, and respectfully circled me, keeping me on my right side, before vanishing right there.
an6.21:5.2: And whoever in the future, mendicants, declines in skillful qualities, all of them do so because of these six qualities.
an6.21:5.3: And whoever in the present, mendicants, is declining in skillful qualities, all of them do so because of these six qualities.”
